title: Forged Beyond Netherite
description: A NeoForge 1.21.1 mod that adds Enderite - a new tier above Netherite - and gives every armor trim pattern a unique ability.
body:
A NeoForge 1.21.1 mod that adds Enderite - a new tier above Netherite - and gives every armor trim pattern a unique ability.

## Enderite Mine **Primordial Debris** in The End, smelt it into **Enderite Scrap**, then craft an **Enderite Ingot** (4 scrap + 4 breeze rods). Upgrade your Netherite gear at a Smithing Table using the **Enderite Upgrade** template. Full set: Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots, Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, Hoe. ## Trim Abilities Every vanilla trim pattern (+ 3 custom ones) grants a passive ability when applied to armor. | Trim | Ability | |---|---| | **Silence** | Invisible to sculk/Wardens. Regen in darkness | | **Ward** | 15% sonic boom on hit. Bonus damage in darkness | | **Bolt** | Lightning immune. 25% lightning strike on ranged hits vs full HP targets | | **Spire** | Faster ender pearls, no pearl damage. Faster elytra flight | | **Rib** | 25% chance to inflict Wither on melee | | **Wayfinder** | Permanent Luck & Hero of the Village II | | **Raiser** | 15% chance slain mobs rise as allies (60s, half HP) | | **Shaper** | +3 block placement reach. Mid-air block placement | | **Host** | 50% lifesteal when target is above 70% HP | | **Snout** | Nether mobs ignore you. Permanent Fire Resistance | | **Eye** | Immune to Blindness/Nausea/Darkness. Crouch to see mobs through walls (6 blocks) | | **Coast** | Regen while in boats. Carry a passenger on your head | | **Dune** | 50% slower hunger drain. Immune to hunger effect | | **Wild** | Reflect negative potion effects back to attackers | | **Sentry** | 75% knockback resistance. Pillagers ignore you | | **Tide** | Permanent Conduit Power. Guardians ignore you | | **Flow** | Double jump | | **Vex** | Vexes ignore you. Slow falling while sneaking midair | | **Wrath** | Strength I for 1.5s when hit | | **Mind** | 2x XP from kills | | **Insomnia** | Phantoms won't spawn for you | ## Setup Requires **NeoForge for Minecraft 1.21.1**. Drop the jar into your `mods` folder. ## Languages English, Polish. ## Note This project was made 4fun for me and my friends' server. It will probably not get updates or ports to other frameworks/engines. ## License MIT
